items.title: Alice Zeno Interview, 1958-12-10
items.q: When he come back I said well now go bring Mr. Edgar Grima's clothes or shirts and collars.

ctx.x: rag dolls for all of us. I was wondering a little bit about the George's early life we didn't get to talk so much to George the other time. No. When he first took up his clarinet and started playing you mentioned you taught him one little song was that on his little flute or on his clarinet? No on the flute. On the flute. How long did he play that

flute before he took his clarinet? He wanted the clarinet you know and George was always small and I thought George wouldn't live to see 15 years I didn't want to give. I said I'll give you a violin but I'll not give you a clarinet because you'll die before you're 15 years old. And he oh no more I don't want no violin I want a clarinet. Well I never did give it to him until one day he asked I sent him to bring because I used to wash plenty shirts and more so. I sent him to bring a basket of clothes by Mr. Grima…
How old was George's father when he when he died? We were 10 years. How old was George?
